remarks: Located within the architecturally significant Seven Lakes Country Club, this residence is a compelling example of midcentury modern design by architect Richard Harrison, reflecting the clean lines, open living spaces, and seamless connection between architecture and the surrounding desert landscape that define the era. The home has been thoughtfully updated while restoring and preserving original architectural details, honoring its midcentury heritage while introducing the comfort and functionality of modern living.
